grade_axis_note: AP has no grade axis. The College Board prescribes no grade for an AP course - schools place them where their sequence allows - so this layer is partitioned by course, one file, rather than by an invented grade10/11/12 split. Same reasoning that omits past_papers/ from the standards frameworks: do not manufacture a distinction the framework does not make.
